name: Mest Ulyanke
source:
A short mod about how retribution catches up sooner or later... Even if sometimes not according to plan.
About how carefully you need to choose your friends, and even more carefully aim at your enemies.
About how much we are responsible for those we have tamed.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=497344578]Steam[/url]]
